properties.text: This whole page is a NavigationSplitView shell - each sidebar entry is a separate, feature-focused JSON file loaded on demand by a LoadableView. browserHistory:web is on, so the browser Back/Forward buttons switch sections. The shell is responsive: narrow the window and it collapses to a single column (a Back arrow returns to the section list); the sidebarAdaptable TabView in Navigation likewise collapses its rail to a top strip.
ActionUIWeb renders SwiftUI-shaped JSON to the DOM - the same documents that drive the Apple and Android renderers. The sections are split by feature so each stays focused.
